title: Multi-Source State & Reconciliation Platform
problem: Build one reusable system that acquires changing heterogeneous public state, preserves identity/provenance/history, reconciles differences, exposes results, and carries operational evidence through the full stack.
constraints: Do not treat one use case or source as the definition of the platform.
Do not claim live AWS deployment from Terraform validation alone.
Do not claim an ability unless an inspectable witness exists.
demonstrated_capability: PostgreSQL persistence, migrations, history, and identity ledgers
heterogeneous API + HTML ingestion and canonicalization
cross-source reconciliation with explicit conflict state
k6 load testing with enforced thresholds
Playwright browser/E2E assertions over seeded live-source evidence
GitHub Actions CI across unit, integration, migration, stack, security, performance, infrastructure, frontend, and browser lanes
controlled upstream and durable-commit failure recovery with preserved prior state
Prometheus alert rules routed to Alertmanager and visualized in Grafana
destructive PostgreSQL backup/restore verification in clean CI

difficulty_evidence.validation_burden: Evidence is carried from source acquisition through persistence/API/UI/CI rather than inferred from isolated code.

external_witness.claim: clean-environment automated execution across project lanes
workflow run 158 passed all project jobs including PostgreSQL recovery, browser UI, Docker observability/alerting, performance, security, Terraform, and destructive backup/restore

failures_and_corrections.issue: Playwright live-data seed was placed in the frontend build job, which did not start the API stack.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Moved the seed into browser-ui after Docker Compose starts the API/frontend stack so the asserted data exists in the same runtime.

failures_and_corrections.issue: Source success originally represented acquisition completion before durable history commit.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Bound durable commit into the operational run boundary so acquisition or commit failure both produce failed source runs.

failures_and_corrections.issue: Per-observation commits could permit a partial durable batch if a later observation failed.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Replaced the persisted source path with one atomic observation batch transaction.

limits: AWS infrastructure is validated configuration; live cloud deployment is still open.
Durable disappeared/stale lifecycle state across complete snapshots remains the next active platform witness.
